market_name: Greenville, NC / ECU / ECU Health visitor market (PetTripFinder discovery scope)

geographic_bounds._disclosure: OBSERVATION box, not an admission boundary. It covers Pitt County's lodging towns and deliberately reaches beyond them -- west to Farmville, south to Grifton and Kinston, east to Washington and north to Tarboro and Williamston -- so that PTF-GREENVILLE-NC-PARALLEL-SOURCE-READY-001 classifies those properties on evidence instead of being blind to them. Admission is decided by the market contract's corridor registry over the property's OWN postal code, never by this box.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~3 decimal places) approximate reference points. They are seed points for bounded-radius queries only; membership is decided by the corridor registry over the property's own postal code.
_boundary_note: PTF-GREENVILLE-NC-PARALLEL-SOURCE-READY-001. A university / medical / convention travel market: the Convention Center / Memorial Drive / Medical District / PGV Airport postal code and the Downtown / ECU postal code are CORE; Winterville is CORRIDOR; Ayden and Simpson are FRINGE. Farmville, Grifton, Kinston, Washington, Tarboro and Williamston are OBSERVED and REFUSED; Rocky Mount, Wilson, New Bern and Greenville SC are named and REFUSED.

explicit_hotel_admissions._what_this_is: The explicit-hotel mechanism, so a single legitimate fringe property never becomes a reason to widen a municipality or a postal code. Empty at authoring time.
